name: @projectx-social/agent
comment: exports points at TypeScript source, not dist, and that is deliberate for now. There is no tsconfig.build.json in this package yet, so declaring a dist entry point would name a directory nothing produces — a package.json that resolves to nothing is worse than one that resolves to source. In-repo consumers run tsx or vitest and read TypeScript directly. Add tsconfig.build.json, a build script and a dist entry before this is published anywhere outside the workspace.
